verdict.rationale: First-party docs show researchers can upload PDFs and other files, up to 500,000 words or 200MB per source. They can then chat with the notebook for grounded answers with in-line citations that link to the quoted passage, and choose which sources the model uses. Community users confirm it is useful for structured research and studying, though one notes friction getting some corpora, such as email, into an accepted format. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of grounding and citation accuracy over a large uploaded corpus.
